newsitem.title: UK: Russian straight run weighs on cracked market.
newsitem.headline: Russian straight run weighs on cracked market.

text.p: Russian straight run high sulphur continues well offered despite unconfirmed rumours of transport difficulties in Russia, traders said on Thursday.
Supplies still overhang the cracked market.
Opinion was divided as to when the expected export tariff would be levied. Some dealers suggested mid Nov while others believed product will be available up to December.
An M-100 cargo was understood sold while E-4s were pegged around $130 cif NWE. Low sulphur straight run was at a standoff.
